assertion_audit.failure_condition: Replacing the retained bank archive or its point ordering makes np.testing.assert_array_equal(data['points'], points) fail, and a zero or emptied archive makes the hessian-norm guard fail; both establish that the reproduction instrument sees a non-empty, correctly ordered archive.

The historical control assertion fails if head-eager/receipt.json stops meeting 1e-8, and the >0.07 assertion fails if the candidate archive stops reproducing the recorded 7-8 percent miss, so the instrument distinguishes a pass from the known-present failure.
Restoring a calibration that compares the measured column with itself, or an insensitive budget.

The assertion fails if the independent node-N.npz reference stops meeting the trace identity or if the reconstructed forcing is wrong, since stored forcing is separately compared at rtol/atol 1e-13 at line 88.

Replacing the sixth-order height column with the four-sample column, or failing to replace the height column at all, reddens this line; small-step-refusal.log records that exact reinstatement refusing at 3.773492043042928e-8 with EXIT=1.
The assertion fails if non-corner targets carry the residual, which reddens if the corner mask or the routing attribution is wrong; the measured fractions are 2.5e-22 and below.

The census receipt's stored rows disagree with a fresh recomputation from the archived bank, or the archive sha256 no longer matches the stop record at report.py:167-169; this is a receipt-integrity check, not an independent measurement.

The candidate kernel begins routing any corner height sample or the non-height JVP through the stable product: the observed {original JVPTracer 2, stable JVPTracer 1, original ArrayImpl 4} profile and the six-samples-per-height-JVP relation both redden.

The scratch intervention changes the primal gradient: assert_allclose against the retained bank and the <=1e-12 relative-change guard fail; the measured change is 5.3e-13 and 384 differing entries, so the guard is close to its observed value.

assertion_independence: No added assertion compares a value with the same variable the run passed in. The closest pair is report.py:180-186, where reproduced['relative'] and candidate['rows'][index]['relative'] both derive from the same retained archive through the same owner trace function; that comparison is a receipt-integrity check and would survive a wrong formula, so it is not counted as coverage of the metric. The measured sixth-order column is compared with node-N.npz reference derivatives and with the physical forcing magnitude, both independent of the diagnostic computation.
